scientific_integrity: The general statement is proved analytically from the entropy Hessian and Hilbert--Schmidt orthogonal decomposition. Numerical checks are supplementary and are not used as an infinite-dimensional or exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional, fixed-Hamiltonian asymptotics as beta tends to zero; no uniform finite-temperature remainder or thermodynamic-limit interchange is claimed. The entropy Hessian is standard, so equivalent formulations under other terminology remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exact infinite-temperature Hessian of Gibbs mutual information and a sharp boundary witness
